trackers.product_line: Mintegral's ad SDK for app developers; Mintegral is Mobvista's programmatic ad platform

consequences.text: In 2020 the security firm Snyk reported that Mintegral's iOS SDK, from version 5.5.1, logged links people tapped and network activity in apps and claimed other networks' ad clicks, and that its Android SDK tracked downloads. Mintegral said the allegations were not true; Apple said it had no evidence the SDK harmed iOS users. Snyk said Mintegral later removed these parts.
consequences.wording: Reported by Snyk (2020), one research team's findings; Mintegral denied them.
